name: DXY down-thrust reclaim — long crypto beta on a decisive dollar breakdown confirmed by a range reclaim (daily)
rationale: MECHANISM: a falling dollar loosens global financial conditions and cheapens the cost of holding dollar-denominated risk — historically BTC's cleanest inverse macro tie. FX is the deepest, slowest-to-fully-transmit macro market: a decisive DXY breakdown re-rates the whole risk complex over days as carry/allocation flows rotate, and retail-fast 24/7 crypto reprices the dollar signal before TradFi mandates rebalance. Trade: long crypto beta when dxy makes a fresh multi-week low (negative dxy RoC) AND crypto confirms with a range reclaim off the floor. Counterparty = macro FX/rates flow on an institutional clock. DISCONFIRMER — THE BIG ONE: JPMorgan (Mar 2026) reports the BTC-dollar correlation FLIPPED POSITIVE for the first time since pre-2014 (the 0.7 inverse decayed to ~0.45 then inverted this ETF cycle). If the sign has flipped, an inverse-DXY long is backwards. Kill unless a strictly OOS 2024-2026 window shows the inverse relationship is STILL live net of fees; do NOT let a strong 2015-2021 in-sample rescue it. High probability already dead.
catalyst: fresh multi-week DXY low with a crypto range reclaim
